subject: RE: FW: AMSTERDAM SCHIPHOL - ULN / 118 CTN 2,333 KGS
body:
Hello,

Our buyer in Miami is importing furniture samples from us in Germany, and we are arranging the flight for their import. Could you please quote your cheapest air freight option for this import shipment to MIA (Miami, US)?

The shipment consists of 10 pieces with a gross weight of 765 kg and a total volume of 4.35 cbm. It will be ready for pickup on 2026-11-26 at our site in 72755 Tuebingen, Germany.

Please quote an all-in price in EUR, including pickup at our site and the truck transport to the departure airport, which you would arrange.

Thank you.

Viele Gruesse / Many greetings
Deniz Yilmaz
Rheintal Elektronik GmbH


-----Original Message-----
Sent: 2026-10-22
Subject: AMSTERDAM SCHIPHOL - ULN / 118 CTN 2,333 KGS

Dear team,

pls quote air freight ex AMSTERDAM SCHIPHOL to ULN:
